title: Lower body · 26 September
label: 40-MINUTE LOWER BODY · ELBOW-FRIENDLY + CALF PT
coachNote: Lower body only today because the right elbow is hurting. Avoid upper-body loading and gripping-heavy work. SUPERSETS: A1 Leg extension → A2 Leg curl, rest 45–60 sec × 3. B1 45° leg press → B2 Hip thrust, rest 75–90 sec × 3. Then calf PT: single-leg standing calf raise 3 × 10 EACH LEG with controlled 3-sec lowering, followed by seated calf raise 3 × 10–12. Finish with elbow-free core if time remains. Do not aggressively progress calf resistance today.

exercises.name: A1 · SUPERSET A — Leg extension
exercises.note: Controlled reps; record the machine load.

exercises.name: A2 · SUPERSET A — Leg curl
exercises.note: Controlled reps. After this exercise rest 45–60 sec, then repeat A1/A2.

exercises.name: B1 · SUPERSET B — 45° leg press
exercises.note: Record plates added and note whether the load includes the sled.

exercises.name: B2 · SUPERSET B — Hip thrust
exercises.target: 3 × 10 · start 45 kg; progress toward 50 kg if first set is easy
exercises.note: Last session was 45 kg × 10 × 3 at RPE 5. Controlled lockout; avoid low-back hyperextension. After this exercise rest 75–90 sec.

exercises.name: PT · Single-leg standing calf raise
exercises.note: PT PRIORITY. Full rise, brief top hold, ~3-second lowering. Use hand support as needed. Last session: RPE 5, pain 3/10; do not aggressively add load today.

exercises.name: PT · Seated calf raise
exercises.note: Controlled full range. Last session RPE 6, pain 2/10. Record actual load if known.

exercises.name: OPTIONAL · Dead bug / reverse crunch
exercises.note: Elbow-free core only if time remains. If doing reverse crunches, enter as substitution.
